title: Antigravity dedup, rescan, and doctor
description: Wire Antigravity into dedupeRecords semantics, incremental rescan (watermark/floor per storage shape), doctorAntigravity reporting counts only, runSentimentMeter default sources, src/index.ts exports, and CLI --doctor output. Done when: meter includes antigravity as a source; doctor reports live counts on BlackbookM1; full suite green.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Done. Wiring consistent with the other sources:
- Dedup: recordIds embed conversation uuid + step idx (stable native ids); scanAdapter union-dedups across roots. Every run is a full rescan with dedup absorbing overlap — identical to the other sources' current behavior (scan-state watermarks remain a shared framework for later).
- Rescan robustness: conversation DBs are heavily WAL-mode (all 79 desktop DBs have -wal sidecars); openSqliteFile in sqlite-reader.ts was refactored out of openVscDb and reused here with copy-then-read snapshot semantics so reads see a consistent state while writers hold the original.
- Doctor: doctorAntigravity() reports per-root present/conversationCount/nestedCount (counts only); wired into the CLI --doctor (text + JSON) with an --antigravity-home override flag; runSentimentMeter default sources now include antigravity; src/index.ts exports the adapter surface.
- Live on BlackbookM1: doctor reports 79 conversations (55 nested skipped) + 37 (0 nested); all-time meter antigravity 448 msgs / 61 sessions / 6 thanks / 24 f-bomb tokens. Full suite green (16/16 sentiment suites, 154 tests; whole-suite run below in 31a852).
